name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
about: PNB Housing Finance offers retail customers housing and non-housing loans, including individual home loans, loan against property, non-resident property loan, among others. It is promoted by Punjab National Bank. [1]
keyPoints:
Service Offerings
The company provides loans to purchase, construct, repair, and upgrade houses. It also provides loans for commercial space, loans against property, and loans for purchasing residential plots. [1]

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.

Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
